title: Definitely worth it!
text:
We did the Barcelona Panorama Tour with Christian. We discovered Barcelona from above and actually experienced places where mass tourism has not reached. The cemetery and the view over Barcelona are impressive, just different and definitely worth a tour.
Thank you Christian for introducing us to Barcelona.
author: Explore12771873279

title: Beautiful Scenary and Out of the Way Places
text: Michael was a fantastic guide, taking us to out of the way places to overlook Barcelona. This is a demanding walk uphill for two hours or so but these are places you would not see otherwise. The castle at the top is excellent and this is a side of the city I would not have seen. You get a good look at the Olympic facilities but do not go inside.
author: Boilerjim1955

title: Worth seeing
text: Make sure to schedule enough time, especially in spring absolutely worth seeing with wonderful views over Barcelona. A wonderful little hike with always surprising information. Book now!:)
author: Murmeltier56

title: Montjuïc walk about
text: Wonderful walk through Olympic and World Expo sites plus extraordinary views of Barcelona.   Get on your walking shoes and have a good time.
author: SteveA1757

title: A lesser-seen and beautiful side of Barcelona with lots of information
text: Christian gave us such a wonderful tour of the lesser-seen side of Montjuic. You could not believe we were in the city it was so beautiful. And along the hike we talked history and economics and politics and all new information about Barcelona. So we made a new friend and had a beautiful view of city. Terrific.
author: smm-california

title: A While New World in Barcelona
text:
As I walked through through the Green Lung of Barcelona I felt like Jasmine on the Magic Carpet with Aladdin experiencing a whole new world!

I was a solo traveler in Barcelona and booked the tour last minute; I was impressed with the accommodations Michael and Christian put fourth so I was able to do the tour.  The tour was with Michael and I felt safe, connected and inquisitive about the grounds we walked!  Michael spoke with such passion and knowledge as we walked it felt like time travel as if you could see the history play out!  All the hidden gems along the way and the sights were SPECTA
author: Jamaica167

title: Discover the Olympic Mountain
text: Michael showed me around the fascinating world of Montjuïc with its spectacular views, nature and history. It was a very pleasant surprise for me that not only it was a private tour, but in Dutch too! Michael is very knowledgeable and I've learned a lot. The fabulous weather was a bonus, thank you very much!!
author: Astrid1965

title: Adventures on Mont Juic
text:
Michael is a really highly recommended guide. Very sympathetic, and the trip with him became a truly unforgettable experience. His humorous manner made the whole thing very personal. Should we be back in Barcelona, we will and surely get back to him!!
Warm greetings 😉
B&U
author: Ulident

title: Fun tour!
text:
We just did a tour with Michael, who was great! He was super enthusiastic and extremely knowledgeable about local culture and history. We learned a ton and really enjoyed talking with him. 

Climbing up the mountain was definitely an experience we wouldn't have had on our own! The description is accurate in that it's a little challenging as it's a lot of uphill walking and stairs, but if you are reasonably fit and wear comfortable shoes it's totally doable. Note: wear plenty of sunblock as the majority of the tour is in direct sunlight with no shade, which we did not expect - so just be aware.
author: daniellerubin
